unit_text:
[Unit]
Description=Hollowdeep original Mordor 3.00 game server
After=network.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
Type=simple
User=hollowdeep
Group=hollowdeep
WorkingDirectory=/srv/hollowdeep/world
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/hollowdeep/kit/manage.py run --work /srv/hollowdeep/world --port 4040
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/srv/hollowdeep/world
TimeoutStopSec=20

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
